stories.title: Meg and the Red Hen
lines: Meg got a red hen.
The hen sat in a big box.
It did not hop up.
Meg put a fig in the pen.
The hen ran and got it!
Ted fed the hen ham.
Meg can hug it.
Yes, the hen is a pet.

stories.title: The Pup and the Bus
lines: Liz had a fat pup.
The pup ran on a bus.
Liz did not get on it.
Liz is sad and mad.
Ben got the pup and ran up.
It hid in his big cap.
Liz can hug the pup!
Yes, Ben is a pal.

stories.title: Kim and the Big Fig
lines: Kim got a big fig.
It is red and fat.
Kim can not cut it.
Dad got a hot pan.
Dad put the fig in a pot.
The fig is jam!
Kim had jam on a bun.
The jam is yum.

stories.title: Rex and the Net
lines: Rex is a tan cat.
Bob got a big red net.
Rex hid in the tub.
Bob can not get him.
Rex ran up on the bed.
Bob put ham in the net.
Rex got the ham and ran!
Bob is not mad at Rex.

stories.title: Max Dug Up a Mug
lines: Max is a big tan dog.
Max can dig in wet mud.
Jim let him dig a lot.
Max dug up a red mug!
Jim put the mug in a tub.
Mom got the mug and hid it.
Max did not get it yet.

stories.title: A Fox on a Log
lines: A fox sat on a log.
Tom the pig got wet.
A red box is in mud.
Fox can not tug it.
Tom can tip the box!
In it is a ham bun.
Yum! Fox and Tom had a bit.

stories.title: I Got a Red Top
lines: I got a red top.
I let it go on the rug.
The top hit a big pot.
Mom did not get mad.
Dad had a mop and a rag.
I got the wet rag.
The rug is wet but fun.
I put the top in a box.

stories.title: Ted Can Not Nap
lines: Ted got in his bed.
It is hot in the hut.
A bug sat on the red rug.
Ted did not nap yet.
Ted put the bug in a cup.
Ted let it go to the web.
At six, Ted can nap.

stories.title: The Jet in the Fog
lines: Tim sat in a big jet.
Up it got, in the fog.
The fog is dim and wet.
Tim had a map on his lap.
It got him to a dam.
Dad and Jan ran up.
Tim had a big hug.

stories.title: Gus and the Bug
lines: Gus sat in the hot sun.
A bug got on his leg.
Gus did not hit it.
It ran up to his cap.
Gus let the bug go.
It hid in a tan bag.
Jen put the bag on a peg.
The bug is a pet!

stories.title: A Bug in a Jug
lines: Bob got a big tin jug.
A bug hid in it.
Bob can not get it up.
Dad put a lid on top.
In the sun, the jug is hot.
The bug hit the lid a lot.
Dad let it go in the mud.
Yes! The bug is not sad.

stories.title: Ken and the Red Van
lines: Ken had a red van.
In it: ham, bun and jam.
A kid ran up to the van.
Can I get a bun?
Yes! Ken put ham on it.
The kid bit the bun.
Yum! It is not bad.
Ken had a fun job.

stories.title: A Bat in the Hut
lines: At six, Pam got in the hut.
A bat hid up on a peg.
It fit in a dim gap.
Pam is not mad at it.
Pam let the bat go.
Up in the fog it ran.
The bat got a big bug.
Pam can sit and hum.

stories.title: Liz Can Fix It
lines: Liz can fix a big cot.
It did not sit up yet.
Liz got a rod and a peg.
Tap, tap! The peg is in.
Ben sat on the cot.
It did not tip!
Liz is not a bad kid.
Ben can nap on it.

stories.title: Gus Got a Pup
lines: Gus had no pet yet.
Dad got him a tan pup.
The pup can hop and run.
It bit a red rug!
Gus did not get mad.
Gus put the rug on a peg.
The pup ran to his lap.
Yes, it is a fun pet.

stories.title: Mix It in the Pot
lines: Mom can mix jam in a pot.
I got a big red yam.
Dad had a fat fig.
Mix, mix! It is hot.
Jan put gum in the pot!
Mom did not let it sit.
The gum is in the bin.
Yum! The jam is not bad.

stories.title: The Wig in the Pit
lines: Nan had a tan wig.
A big fan hit it.
The wig is in a wet pit!
Nan can not get it.
Rex the dog dug in mud.
Up it got, and Rex ran.
Nan put the wig on a peg.
It is wet, but not bad.

stories.title: Meg and the Wet Cat
lines: A cat sat in a wet bin.
Meg got it and ran in.
The cat had a bit of ham.
It hid in a big hat.
Meg let it nap.
At six, the cat got up.
It can sit on a lap.
Meg has a pet!

stories.title: The Big Mud Pit
lines: Tom and Jan dig in wet mud.
A fat pig hid in the pit.
Tom can not tug him up.
Jan got a bun and a fig.
The pig ran up to it!
Up to the pen, big pig.
Yes! It is a fun job.

stories.title: I Can Dig a Pit
lines: I can dig a big pit.
Dad got a tin cup.
I dug in the wet mud.
Up got a red pin!
I ran to Mom.
Mom had on a tan hat.
The pin can go on it!
Yes! Dad and I had fun.

stories.title: Bob and the Vet
lines: Rex the dog did not get up.
Bob is sad.
A cab got him to the vet.
The vet had a big kit.
The vet put a pad on it.
Rex can hop and run!
Bob got a big hug.

stories.title: The Bug in the Web
lines: A big web is on a log.
A bug got in it.
Kim can rip the web!
Up the bug got and hid.
It sat on a red bud.
Kim did not get mad.
Yes, a bug is a pal.

stories.title: The Rat in the Lab
lines: A rat got in the lab.
It hid in a tin bin.
Ben and Liz ran up.
Liz put ham on a red pad.
Up ran the rat to get it!
Ben had a big box.
In it, the rat did sit.
Ben let it go in mud.

stories.title: Jen and the Big Box
lines: A big box is at the hut.
Jen can not tug it in.
Ted and Kim ran up.
Ted, Kim and Jen tug a lot.
In the box: a tan rug.
Mom let Jen put it in.
Yes! The hut is not bad.

stories.title: The Pup and the Nut
lines: Gus the pup got a nut.
It is hot in the sun.
Gus dug a pit in mud.
In it, the nut sat.
A big hog ran up.
The hog got the nut!
Gus can not win a hog.
Dad let him get a bun.

stories.title: Max in the Tub
lines: Max the dog is in mud.
Mom got a big tub.
Max did not get in yet.
Dad put ham on a tin lid.
Up got Max, in the tub!
Rub, rub! It is not tan.
Max ran to the red rug.
The rug is wet. Mom is mad!

stories.title: A Hen on a Log
lines: A red hen sat on a log.
In it hid a fat bug.
The hen did not get him.
Tom ran up to the log.
Tom can tip it a bit.
Up the bug got!
Yes! The hen got a bug.

stories.title: The Cab to the Dam
lines: Jan got in a tan cab.
The cab ran to a big dam.
A fat ox sat on the mud.
It did not get up.
Jan and the man tug a lot.
Up got the ox!
At six, Jan is in bed.

stories.title: Wax in the Hot Sun
lines: Kim had a bit of red wax.
It sat on a tin lid.
The sun is hot.
The wax did not sit up.
It ran and got in a gap!
Kim can not fix it.
Mom put the lid in a tub.
Yes! Kim can get it up.

stories.title: Liz and the Tin Box
lines: Liz got a tin box.
It has a big red lid.
Liz can not get it up.
Ted had a rod.
Tap! Up got the lid.
In it: a wig and a pin.
Liz put the wig on Ted.
Ted is a hit!

stories.title: Ken and the Wet Mop
lines: Ken had a job in the hut.
A jug of jam did tip.
Jam is on the mat!
Ken got a wet mop.
Ken can mop a lot.
The mat is red, not tan.
Mom let Ken sit and hum.
It is a big job!

stories.title: Ted and the Yak
lines: Ted got a big tan yak.
It can not fit in the van.
The yak sat on the mat.
Mom did not let it in.
Ted put a hat on it.
Up the yak got, and ran.
Ted ran to get him.
Yes! The yak is a pet.

stories.title: Nan and the Hot Bun
lines: Nan can mix a big bun.
In it: jam, fig and a nut.
The pot is hot.
Nan let it sit a bit.
Up it got, fat and tan!
Ben and Jan ran in.
Yum! The bun is not bad.
Nan had no bun yet!

stories.title: Tim Got a Job
lines: Tim got a job at a hut.
In a big bin: a red fig.
A man ran up to Tim.
Can I get six?
Tim put the fig in a bag.
The man got in a tan cab.
Tim had a lot of fun.
It is not a bad job!

stories.title: The Hog in the Pen
lines: A fat hog is in a pen.
It has a big gap!
Up got the hog, and ran.
Meg ran to a mud pit.
In it, the hog did sit.
Dad had a bun and a fig.
Yum! Up got the hog.
Meg can pat him.

stories.title: A Pin in the Rug
lines: Jan had a red pin.
It hid in a big tan rug.
Mom and Dad dug a lot.
Rex the cat sat on top.
Rex can tap at it!
Up got the pin, not a bug.
Yes! Jan put it in a box.

stories.title: Kim and the Big Fan
lines: It is hot in the hut.
Kim got a big red fan.
It did not go, not a bit.
Dad had a rod and a peg.
Tap, tap! Up it got.
The fan can go!
Kim sat and had a nap.
Mom and Jen ran in to nap.

stories.title: The Dog and the Log
lines: A big log is in the mud.
Rex the dog got on it.
It did tip!
Rex is wet and mad.
Bob ran up to get him.
Bob had a red rag.
Rub, rub! Rex is not tan.
Yes, Rex can sit on a rug.

stories.title: I Can Hop
lines: I can hop on a mat.
Mom can not hop.
Dad did hop a bit!
I can hop up to the bed.
Jan and Tim ran in.
Hop, hop! It is fun.
Mom got a big red rug.
Hop on it, not the bed!

stories.title: Sam and the Wet Hat
lines: Sam had a tan hat.
It got in a tub of mud.
Sam is sad.
Nan put it in a big pot.
Rub, rub! The mud is up.
The hat sat in the hot sun.
At six, Sam got it.
It is tan, and not wet!

stories.title: A Bud in the Pot
lines: Meg put a bud in a pot.
It did not get big.
Meg had a jug and a cup.
Meg can wet it a lot.
In the sun it sat.
Up it got, red and fat!
Mom put it on a big mat.
Yes! Meg is not sad.

stories.title: Jim and the Big Net
lines: Jim had a big red net.
A bug got in the hut.
It hid up on a peg.
Jim can not get him.
The net is on the bug!
Jim let it go in the fog.
Mom is not mad at Jim.

stories.title: Gus Can Not Sit
lines: Gus the pup can not sit.
Up and up it got!
Ted had a bit of ham.
Sit, Gus, sit!
The pup did sit on a rug.
Yum! It got the ham.
Mom ran in to pat him.
Gus is not a bad dog.

stories.title: The Red Cap
lines: Ben had a red cap on.
A big fan got it up!
It hit the top of a van.
Ben can not tug it in.
Max the dog ran up.
Max can hop on a bin.
Up got the cap, wet and bad!
Ben did not get mad at him.

stories.title: A Nap in the Sun
lines: A tan cat sat in the sun.
It did not get up.
A pup ran up to it.
Yap, yap! Up got the cat.
It hid in a tin tub.
Liz got the pup a bun.
At six, the cat can nap.

stories.title: Tom and the Hot Pot
lines: Tom can mix a pot of jam.
In it: fig, yam and a nut.
It is hot, not wet.
Jan got a red cup.
Mom ran in to get a bun.
Jam and a bun: yum!
Tom had a bit on his lip.
Yes! It is a big hit.

stories.title: A Bat in the Bin
lines: Ted had a big tin bin.
In it hid a bat!
Ted got a lid and a rod.
Up the bat got, and ran.
It sat up on a wet log.
Mom ran in to get a net.
The bat can go in the fog.
Yes! Ted is not sad.

stories.title: A Cub in the Den
lines: A cub sat in a dim den.
It has no bed yet.
Mom got a big red rug.
The cub can nap on it.
A bug ran up his leg!
Up got the cub and hid.
Mom put the bug in a cup.
At six, the cub had a nap.

stories.title: Ken Can Jog
lines: Ken got up at six.
Jog, jog! It is fun.
A dog ran up to him.
The dog can jog a lot.
Ken is hot and wet.
Mom got him a tin cup.
Sip, sip! It is not hot.
The dog had a bit of ham.

stories.title: A Rip in the Bag
lines: Jen had a big red bag.
In it: a bun and a fig.
A rip is in the bag!
The bun got in the mud.
A pup ran up to it.
Yum! The pup can win.
Jen did not get mad.
Mom can fix the rip.

stories.title: The Kid on the Bus
lines: A kid got on a red bus.
It is not a big bus.
In it: Ben, Jen and a dog.
The dog sat on his lap.
Up got the kid at the dam.
Yap! The dog ran to him.
Ben can not get it up.
Jen had a bit of ham!

stories.title: Mom Got a Job
lines: Mom got a job at a lab.
In it: a rat and a hen.
Mom can fix a bad leg.
A big dog ran in!
It did not sit up.
Mom put a pad on him.
Up got the dog, and ran.
Yes! It is a fun job.

stories.title: Jam on a Hot Dog
lines: At six, Dad got a pot.
In it: a hot dog.
Sam had a big bun.
Dad put the dog in it.
Can I put jam on it?
Yes, Sam. Get the jam.
Sam had a bit. It is bad!
Dad got him a red fig.

stories.title: The Pig in the Tub
lines: A fat pig is in mud.
Liz got a big tin tub.
Up got the pig, and in it.
Liz can rub a lot.
The pig did not sit yet.
Mom had a bit of ham.
The pig sat and had it.
Yum! It is not mud.

stories.title: A Fox at the Hen Pen
lines: A fox got up at six.
It ran to a hen pen.
In it sat a fat hen.
Rex the dog ran up!
Yap! The fox hid.
Bob got a net and a bag.
The fox is in it!
Bob let him go.

stories.title: Ted Can Not Win
lines: Ted and Ben can run a lot.
Get set! Go!
Ben ran to the big log.
Ted did not win.
Ted is sad and mad.
Ben got him a red cup.
In it: a bit of jam.
Yes! Ted can sit and sip.

stories.title: A Bib and a Bun
lines: Kim had a big red bib.
Mom got a bun and a fig.
Kim can not sit yet.
Up, up! It is fun.
The bun got on the rug!
Max the dog ran in.
Yum! It is not bad.
Mom did not get mad.

stories.title: Up on the Cot
lines: Jim put a cot in the hut.
It has a tan pad on top.
Up got Jim, and sat.
Tip, tip! It can not sit.
Jim is in the mud!
Dad ran in to get him.
A peg is not in the leg.
Tap, tap! Up got the cot.

stories.title: Max and the Ox
lines: Max the dog ran to a pen.
In it sat a big tan ox.
Max did yap a lot.
The ox got up, mad and hot.
Up on a log Max hid.
Bob ran in to get him.
The ox did not hit Max.
Yes! Bob can hug his dog.

stories.title: The Bud and the Bug
lines: A red bud sat on a pot.
A bug got up on it.
Kim can not get him.
Dad had a big tin can.
In it, the bug did sit.
Kim ran to the mud.
Let it go, Kim!
Up the bug got, and ran.

stories.title: Liz and the Red Mug
lines: Liz got a red mug.
In it: a fig and jam.
Up on a peg it sat.
Rex the cat can hop up.
Tip! It got on the rug.
Liz is mad at Rex.
Mom had a wet mop.
It is not a big job.

stories.title: A Zip on the Bag
lines: Nan got a big tan bag.
It has a red zip.
In it: a pen and a pad.
Jen can not zip it up.
A nut is in the zip!
Dad had a big tin rod.
Tap! Up got the nut.
Zip! Jen can run to the bus.

stories.title: Pop! The Gum
lines: Tim had a bit of red gum.
Pop! It got on his lip.
Mom can not get it up.
Jan had a wet rag.
Rub! It is not on him.
The gum is in a bin.
Mom got him a fig.
No gum yet, Tim!

stories.title: Up at Ten
lines: Bob did not get up at six.
The sun is up. It is hot.
Mom ran in to his bed.
Up, Bob! It is ten!
Bob got up and ran.
The big red bus ran on.
Bob can not get it.
Dad got him in a cab.

stories.title: The Big Vat
lines: Dad had a big tin vat.
In it: hot red jam.
Sam can not get up to it.
Dad got him a big box.
Up got Sam, and did mix.
Mix, mix! It is a lot.
Jam on a bun is yum.
Sam had a lot of it.

stories.title: A Dot on the Pad
lines: Jen got a red pen.
Dot, dot, dot!
A big cat is on the pad.
It has a fat tan leg.
Mom put it up on a peg.
Dad had a big tin pin.
Tap! It can not tip.
Jen got a fig and a hug.

stories.title: Sam and the Gas Can
lines: The red van did not go.
It has no gas in it.
Sam ran to the hut.
In it: a big gas can.
Dad put the gas in.
Up got the van, and ran!
Sam had a map on his lap.
At ten, it is at the dam.

stories.title: A Dip in the Pot
lines: Meg can mix a dip.
In it: ham, nut and a fig.
Dad got a big bag.
Dip, dip! It is yum.
Ben had a lot of it.
Gus the pup ran up.
Up on the mat it got!
The dip is in the pup!

stories.title: The Web on the Peg
lines: A big web is on a peg.
In it sat a fat bug.
Nan can not get it up.
Mom had a wet mop.
Up the bug got, and ran.
It hid in a tin cup.
Nan let it go in the sun.
No web is on the peg!

stories.title: Max Can Wag
lines: Max the pup can wag a lot.
Wag, wag! It is fun.
A mug is on a mat.
Wag! The mug did tip.
Jam got on the rug!
Mom is mad at Max.
Dad had a wet rag.
Rub! The rug is red, not tan.

stories.title: A Pal in the Van
lines: Gus had no pal yet.
A tan van got to the hut.
In it: a kid, Ben.
Ben had a red bat.
Hit it up, Gus!
Up it got, on the big log.
Gus ran to get it.
Ben and Gus had a fig.

stories.title: Mom Got Us a Pup
lines: Mom had a big box.
In it: a tan pup!
It can not sit yet.
Ben fed it a bit of ham.
Liz got a red rug.
The pup can nap on it.
At ten, it did not nap.
Up, up! It is fun.
Mom let us hug it.

stories.title: Nan Can Hum
lines: Nan can hum a lot.
Hum, hum! It is fun.
Ben got a big tin pot.
Tap, tap! Ben can hit it.
Liz had a cup and a rod.
Kim and Jen ran in.
Up got Mom. It is a lot!
At ten, Dad had a nap.

stories.title: The Fig and the Fox
lines: A fox sat in a wet den.
It had no ham, no bun.
Up on a log: a red fig!
The fox did hop and hop.
A big hen ran up.
The hen can tip the log.
Yum! Fox and hen had a bit.

stories.title: Ben Can Fix a Bus
lines: A red bus sat in the fog.
It did not run.
Ben had a big kit.
In it: a rod and a pin.
Tap, tap! Ben can fix it.
Up got the bus, and ran!
Kim and Tim got on.
Yes! Ben had a fun job.

stories.title: A Bug in the Bed
lines: Kim got in bed at ten.
A bug sat on the pad.
Kim did not nap.
Up got Kim, and ran to Mom.
Mom had a cup and a lid.
In it, the bug did sit.
Dad let it go in a bud.
At six, Kim had a big nap.

stories.title: The Kid and the Cub
lines: Jen ran up to a dim den.
In it: a tan cub!
It is not big yet.
Jen fed it a bit of nut.
A big ox ran up.
Jen hid in a wet log.
The ox let the cub go.
At ten, Jen ran to Dad.

stories.title: Dad Got a Wig
lines: Dad got a big tan wig.
It sat on his hat.
Jan did not get it.
Up in the fan it got!
Dad ran and ran.
Rex the dog got it.
Yap! The wig is in mud.
Mom got a tub and a mop.
At six, Dad had no wig.

stories.title: A Mop, a Pot and a Pan
lines: Mom had a job in the hut.
Tap! A pot did tip.
Jam and gum got on the mat!
Ben got a big wet mop.
Liz had a tin pan.
Mop, mop! The mat is red.
Mom can not get mad.
Yum! Ben had a fig bun.

stories.title: The Bus in the Mud
lines: A red bus got in wet mud.
It did not run yet.
Kim and Gus got up.
Ben had a big log.
Up it got, on the mud.
Tug, tug! The bus can go!
At six, it is at the hut.
Yes! Kim had a fig.

stories.title: Up on the Mat
lines: Tim can hop up on a mat.
Hop, hop! It is fun.
Jen sat on a big red cot.
Up got Jen, and did hop.
Tip! The cot did not sit.
Mom ran in to get us.
No hop on a cot!
Tim and Jen sat in the sun.

stories.title: A Hat in the Fog
lines: The fog is dim and wet.
Bob had a tan hat on.
Up it got, in the fog!
Max the dog ran to it.
Up on a big log Max got.
In his lip: the hat!
Bob can hug his pet.
At six, it is not wet.

stories.title: A Cat, a Rat and a Bat
lines: In the hut: a tan cat.
Up on a peg: a bat.
In a tin bin: a fat rat.
Nan got up at six.
Mom had a big red net.
Up got the bat, and it hid.
The cat did run to the rat.
At ten, Nan had a nap.

stories.title: Jim and the Red Kit
lines: Jim got a red kit.
In it: a pin and a pad.
A cut is on his leg.
Mom put the pad on it.
Jim did not sob.
Dad got him a fig bun.
Up got Jim, and ran to Ben.
Yes! Jim can jog a lot.

stories.title: Gus Got Wet
lines: Gus the pup sat in a tub.
Ben can rub him a lot.
Up got Gus, and ran!
Wet dog on the red rug!
Mom is not mad yet.
Jen had a big tan rag.
Rub, rub! It is not wet.
At six, Gus had a nap.

stories.title: Kim Can Jig
lines: Kim can jig on a mat.
Jig, jig! Up and up!
Ben hit a tin pot.
Tap, tap, tap!
Mom got up and did jig.
Dad can not jig yet.
Up got Dad! It is fun.
At ten, Mom had a nap.

stories.title: The Cup and the Pup
lines: Liz had a big tin cup.
In it: a bit of ham.
Max the pup ran in.
It can not get the cup.
Up on a peg Liz put it.
Max did sob a bit.
Liz fed him a red fig.
Yum! Max is not sad.

stories.title: A Nap at Ten
lines: At ten, Mom got in bed.
The hut is dim and hot.
A big bug did hum.
Hum, hum! Mom did not nap.
Up got Mom, and got a cup.
Dad let it go in the fog.
At six, Mom had a big nap.

stories.title: Liz Can Run
lines: Liz can run a lot.
Get set! Run, Liz, run!
Up on a log, and in mud!
Ben can not win.
At the dam, Liz got up.
Mom had a rag and a bun.
Yum! Liz had a big bit.
Ben got a fig.

stories.title: A Rat in the Van
lines: Ted had a big red van.
In it: a bag of nut.
A rat got in at six.
Rip! The nut is on a mat.
Ted did not get mad.
Mom had a tin box.
In it, the rat sat.
Ted let it go in a log.

stories.title: A Bit of Ham
lines: Nan had a bit of ham.
Up got Rex, the fat cat.
It can not get it yet.
Up on a big tin bin!
Nan ran in to get him.
Rex had the ham, and hid.
In a red tub it sat.
Nan is not mad at Rex.

stories.title: A Job in the Sun
lines: At six, Bob got a job.
It is hot.
Bob can dig a big pit.
In it: a rod and a rim.
Dig, dig! Up got a tin box.
In it: a wig and a pin.
Bob ran to Mom and Dad.
Mom put the wig on Dad.

stories.title: Dad Can Not Nap
lines: Dad got in bed at ten.
Max the dog did yap.
Yap, yap, yap!
Dad got up and ran in.
A big bug is on the rug.
Max can not get it.
Dad had a cup and a lid.
At six, Dad had a nap.

stories.title: Jam in the Bin
lines: Jen had a big pot of jam.
It did not fit in the tin.
Mom put a bit in a cup.
Tip! The pot got in the bin.
Jam is on the lid!
Jen had a wet rag.
Rub, rub! It is not red.
Mom got us a fig bun.

stories.title: At the Big Dam
lines: Ben and Kim ran to the dam.
It is big and wet.
A hen sat on a log.
Up got a fat ox!
Ben hid in the mud.
Kim did not run yet.
The ox got in a van.
At ten, Kim had a fig bun.

stories.title: Bob Got a Bat
lines: Bob got a big red bat.
Ken had a tin can.
Hit it up, Bob!
Up it got, on a wet hut!
Max the dog ran to get it.
Yap! Up got the can.
Ken and Bob had a fig.
At six, Mom let us in.

stories.title: The Hen and the Nut
lines: A red hen ran in a pen.
It got a big nut.
A fat pig ran up to it.
The pig can not get it.
Meg had a tin cup of gum.
Pop! The pig ran to Meg.
Yum! The hen had the nut.
At six, Meg fed us a bun.

stories.title: A Hug at Ten
lines: Kim did not nap at ten.
It is dim in the hut.
A big fan did hum.
Kim got up and ran.
Mom sat on a red cot.
Kim had a big hug.
Mom fed Kim a bit of fig.
At six, Kim got up.

stories.title: Tim and the Wet Map
lines: Tim had a big map.
It got in a tub of mud.
Tim can not get to the dam.
Ben had a red pen.
Dot, dot! Ben can fix it.
Up got Tim, and ran.
At ten, it is at the dam.
Yes! Ben is a big pal.

stories.title: Jen and the Hot Sun
lines: It is hot. Jen is wet.
Mom got a big tan hat.
Jen put it on.
A fan is in the van.
Up got Jen, and ran to it.
Ben had a cup and a jug.
Sip, sip! It is not hot.
At six, Jen had a nap.
